description: This PHP source file defines the AdministratorAccessSubscriber class which subscribes to kernel controller events to manage administrator access privileges based on the controller type.

classes.name: AdministratorAccessSubscriber
classes.description: A class that subscribes to kernel controller events to modify user admin access based on the controller handling the request.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Returns the list of events this subscriber listens to, specifically the controller event with a high priority.

methods.name: onControllerEvent
methods.description: Handles the controller event, setting admin access privileges to false if the current controller is an instance of AbstractVueController.
